title: Terms and Conditions
body:
Please read these terms carefully before using the Jumbo Sales website or placing an order with us. By browsing this site or contacting us to order, you agree to these terms.

Product Information and Pricing. We make every effort to display accurate product descriptions, specifications and pricing. However, prices, availability and specifications are subject to change without notice, and should be confirmed with us directly (via WhatsApp, phone, or the site's quote request) before you place an order, as market prices for hardware and construction materials can change. Product photos are, wherever possible, real photos of the actual products we stock; where a placeholder image is shown, this is clearly marked and does not represent final product appearance.

Orders. Orders are placed by contacting us directly — via WhatsApp, phone call, or the "Add to Cart" and quote request features on this site, which generate a WhatsApp message summarising your order. An order is only confirmed once we have acknowledged it and agreed on final price, quantity and delivery terms with you directly. Nothing on this website constitutes a binding offer to sell at the listed price until confirmed by us.

Payment. Payment terms are agreed directly between you and Jumbo Sales at the time of ordering. This website does not process payments or store payment information.

Delivery. Delivery availability, timing and cost depend on your location, the products ordered, and order size, as described on our Delivery page. Delivery is arranged directly with you after order confirmation.

Cancellations. Orders may be cancelled or amended before dispatch by contacting us directly. Once materials have been dispatched or custom-cut to your specification, cancellation may not be possible — ask us about the specific product you're ordering if this matters to you.

Intellectual Property. The content, design and product photography on this website belong to Jumbo Sales and may not be copied or reused without permission.

Limitation of Liability. While we take care to ensure the information on this site is accurate, Jumbo Sales is not liable for losses arising from reliance on website content where that information has not been separately confirmed with us before purchase.

Governing Law. These terms are governed by the laws of Kenya.

Contact. Questions about these terms can be directed to us via the details on our Contact page.
